title: TAT-3175: perps UI interaction reports button_clicked; perps events carry environment_type
description: Fixed tree: tapping 'Learn the basics' on Perps home emits exactly one Perp UI Interaction with button_clicked=tutorial (no legacy button_type) and environment_type=fullscreen; the geo-block modal's screen_type=geo_block_notif is proven by its unit test. Preconditions: MetaMetrics participation already enabled in the fixture wallet (optedIn=true); Build has SEGMENT_HOST=http://localhost:8667 and a non-empty SEGMENT_WRITE_KEY so events reach the harness collector.

setup-unlock.intent: Make sure the wallet UI is unlocked

setup-capture.intent: Start the local Segment collector and take a cursor for this flow

ac3-wait-learn-basics.intent: Learn-the-basics button is visible on Perps home

ac3-press-learn-basics.intent: Open the Perps tutorial as a user would, producing one button interaction event

ac3-assert-ui-interaction.intent: The button tap names the button via button_clicked=tutorial, matching mobile

ac3-read-events.intent: Keep the raw Perp UI Interaction payload as evidence

gate-kill-capture-helper.intent: Clear orphaned capture helpers so the screenshot uses the real capture path

ac3-screenshot-perps-home.label: AC3 orientation: Perps home with the Learn-the-basics button
ac3-screenshot-perps-home.intent: Show reviewers which Perps home button the interaction event describes

ac1-open-perps-tab.intent: Open Perps from wallet home (account-overview Perps tab, or the bottom nav when that layout is enabled), which reports a Perp Screen Viewed

ac3-scroll-learn-basics.intent: Reveal the education section at the bottom of Perps home so the tutorial entry point is on screen

ac2-run-geo-block-test.intent: Prove the geo-block notice reports screen_type=geo_block_notif (slot cannot be geo-blocked live)

ac2-assert-geo-block-test.intent: The geo_block_notif screen-view test ran and passed

teardown-wait-tutorial.intent: The tutorial opened by the button tap is on screen and can be dismissed

teardown-close-tutorial.intent: Dismiss the tutorial so the next run starts from a clean wallet home

setup-open-tokens-tab.intent: Start from the Tokens tab so opening Perps is a fresh screen view

setup-wait-tokens-tab.intent: The Tokens tab is the active wallet home tab
